dense_hotspot_rule: n_hi > control tile p99 AND f_in >= 0.8
f_in_rule: n_sheet / (n_sheet + n_gap_lo + n_gap_hi), voxels > T_hi; 13 sheet vs 54 gap slices, so a depth-uniform population gives 13/67 = 0.194

rot90_null.note: n_hi, f_in and the radial autocorrelation are rotation-invariant by construction; the rot-90 copy only swaps the directional peaks, so it cannot separate text from non-text on these statistics. The discriminating null is the known-text control.
